title: Eyes
shortDescription: A study of gaze and perception — original handpainted work on canvas.
longStory: Eyes holds the viewer in a fixed exchange. Painted by Giuseppe Fioretti, the work treats the gaze as both subject and material: repetition, intensity, and the quiet pressure of being looked at. An original painting — offered as a single piece.

title: Tutti in Uno
shortDescription: Mixed media on canvas — form, colour and composition held in one surface.
longStory: Tutti in Uno gathers opposing energies into a single field. Layers of mixed media build a dense, restless composition where figure and ground refuse to settle. An original work by Giuseppe Fioretti — one canvas, one presence.

title: Blue Study
shortDescription: Ink and colour on paper — a handpainted study of line, blue and the eye.
longStory: Blue Study isolates a fragment of vision. Ink and acrylic on paper trace a motif that is both anatomical and abstract: the eye as mark, as colour, as pause. A handpainted original — intimate in scale, absolute in presence.

title: Grid
shortDescription: Ink on paper — texture, repetition and the body as material.
longStory: Grid explores the body through structure. Dense ink marks build a field of texture and repetition until the figure becomes pattern and the pattern becomes skin. An original drawing — now in a private collection.
